Since the release of the first iPhone in 2007, more than half of Apple's iPhone announcements have taken place in September. Most recently, Apple announced the iPhone 17 lineup and iPhone Air on Sept. 9, 2025.

Aside from the iPhone 18, tech insiders are hopeful Apple will announce the first foldable iPhone, though details about such a product have yet to be shared.
